steps.text: Go inspect Awowogei in Lumbridge Castle.
Inspect Awowogei.
Talk to Awowogei on Ape Atoll.
Talk to the three monkeys sat in the temple.
choices: Do you know anything about the King's favourite dish?

steps.text: Use a banana on the one of the three monkeys.
Use some monkey nuts on the one of the three monkeys.
Travel to Crash Island with Lumdo.
Enter the hole on Crash Island. Protect melee when entering as you'll be attacked straight away by snakes.
choices: Yes, I'm as hard as nails.

steps.text: Kill a Big Snake for its corpse. Kill a few in case you burn it.
Leave the hole.
Travel back to Ape Atoll with Lumdo.
Use a rope on the red banana tree on the north west of Ape Atoll as a gorilla.
Go around the monkey agility course until you reach a hole, and go down it.
Take a nut from the bush.
Use a pestle and mortar on the tchiki nuts. Get more tchiki nut paste as desired in case you burn the final meal.
Use a knife/slash weapon on the red banana. Get more sliced red bananas as desired in case you burn the final meal.
Use the paste on the snake to stuff it.
Enter the trapdoor in the monkey temple.
Enter the hole just under where you entered.
Go across the hot rocks with the zombie greegree equipped. Cook the stuffed snake on the rock at the end of the room.
Go give the snake to Awowogei to finish the quest.
Give the snake to Awowogei to finish the quest.
